name: Twenty4Tim: Love Hunter
overview: Everyone knows Twenty4Tim – but no one has ever seen the real Tim as private as he is now. For the first time, he embarks on a quest for his true love and faces 12 potential partners. But not everyone is playing fair: Amidst honest emotions, wild parties, and manipulative schemes, Tim must figure out who he can truly trust. Will he finally find his soulmate in this idyllic setting, or will his heart be broken in the end?
